exposure: History of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) with uterine preservation surgery in a previous pregnancy
outcome: Composite adverse outcome (CAO) including uterine dehiscence
cohort: Women who had uterine preservation surgery after a previous Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) pregnancy and experienced a subsequent pregnancy that reached viability, compared to a control group of women without a history of PAS.
finding: A history of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) in a previous pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of composite adverse outcomes (CAOs) in subsequent pregnancies.
